note: English versions of the set-6 and set-7 commands for text-to-motion models that take English (HumanML3D style: 'A person ...'). Translated by Claude on 2026-11-12, keeping each command's meaning without adding details. The plain walk of every model is 'A person walks forward.' Sets 9 and 10 added on 2026-11-16, translated the same way after our models had been run on them.
